---
title: "Research"
---

My research is situated within **applied economics**, with particular interests in the economic determinants of health and well-being, inequalities, ageing, and the evaluation of public policies. I use quantitative methods and microeconometric approaches to study these topics.

## Research interests

- **Health Economics:** health inequalities, healthcare utilisation, health-related behaviours and economic evaluation.
- **Public Economics:** social protection, redistribution and public policy.
- **Economics of Ageing and Long-Term Care:** later-life well-being, care needs and access to services.
- **Applied Microeconometrics:** quantitative analysis of individual- and population-level data.
- **Public Policy Evaluation:** assessment of policy outcomes and impacts.

## Research collaborations

My research has involved the Department of Economics at the University of Cantabria and the Valdecilla Biomedical Research Institute (IDIVAL), as well as participation in national and European research projects.
